status_meaning: All twelve saved forward records and bounded arithmetic were reviewed; no new assistance-quality acceptance.
findings: In all four previously failed first-divergence pairs, enabling this adapter changes the relative margin from favoring the canonical token to favoring the historical emitted token, under the same fixed prefix and forward settings.
The adapter-enabled top1 at each of those four positions equals the historical emitted token. This matches those local choices, not a replay of the whole generated answer.

For Chinese owner and English withdrawal restoration, the canonical-token absolute probability increases, but the historical-token probability increases more. Only the English owner and English uncertainty cases show decreased canonical-token absolute probability.
Disabled top1 is canonical in only two of the four positions. The other two disabled top1 IDs are 2198, a third token. Positive pairwise margins do not establish disabled free-generation success.
All six canonical JSON-body mean NLL values are lower with the adapter. Better average teacher-forced likelihood coexists with worse relative preference at these four critical token pairs.
The Chinese withdrawal wording difference remains a successful semantic variant; the Chinese uncertainty output matches through EOS. Neither is reclassified as a failure.
interpretation_limits: This is a bounded conditional effect of enabling the frozen adapter on six exposed training prompts and fixed target prefixes, not a training-data, optimizer or epoch causal identification.
BPE single-token alternatives do not give the probability of a complete list closure, empty patch, repair or action sequence. In particular, delimiter fragments do not force their later continuation.
After the first divergence, the canonical target supplies history that differs from the original generated output. Subsequent high target likelihood cannot certify autonomous repair.
One successful answer uses different wording; canonical likelihood does not sum over all semantically valid answers.
Full-prefix no-cache scoring differs from historical cached generation. Local top1 agreement in four failure positions does not prove bitwise equivalence or complete decoding replay.
Arm order is fixed, with no repeat or randomized crossover. No uncertainty interval, generalization claim or production quality gain is supported.

Full vocabulary logits were not retained. This review recomputes arithmetic from saved token statistics and checks rank/top1 consistency; rank computations are supported by the frozen source and earlier CPU control, not independently recalculated from raw vocabulary logits.
This follow-up has twelve new forward calls and zero generations; prior eighteen generation calls and their frozen reviews remain separate.
stop_decision: The assigned twelve forwards are complete. No additional model call, candidate ranking, prompt variant or training is requested by this review.
